name: Kiriyama Riri
source:
A crossdressing maid sent from the Senjuin main household.
Shizuka’s younger sister and a devoted “big sis” fan.
She does her job...technically speaking...but her efforts are always misdirected, leading to poor results.
She is constantly making mistakes and getting scolded by both Asuka and Mahiro.
She and Asuka go way back, and practically have a love-hate relationship.
